title: A staker promoted when the tree grows keeps being paid at the lower rate
rootCause: LayerEdgeStaking._checkBoundariesAndRecord records a tier change for the wrong rank when the staker count grows and the tier 2 size stays put, so the staker who should move from tier 3 to tier 2 is never recorded as moved, while getUserAPY reports the tier 2 rate from the current rank.

poc.observable: test_staker_is_paid_the_rate_it_is_told fails with "interest paid at the stated rate: 20000000000000000000 != 35000000000000000000"
